title: GlanceBar: compact observability strip for onboarding (latency, token-cost, trace preview)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a single-row compact observability overlay called 'GlanceBar' intended for first-run onboarding and quickstart tours. The GlanceBar should sit at the top of the Console quickstart modal and provide an at-a-glance summary across three micro-widgets: 1) latency heatstrip (p95/p99 markers), 2) token-cost sparklines (cost per response and per-token rate), and 3) mini-trace preview (collapsed flame/trace with hover expansion). Deliverable includes pixel-perfect screenshots for release notes, annotated export specs for engineering, and a short micro-tutorial screenshot sequence for the in-app tour.
acceptance_criteria: Three micro-widgets implemented in Figma with responsive layout for narrow (320px) and wide (1440px) widths
Annotated screenshot set: hero (full-width modal with GlanceBar), hover-expanded trace preview, and cost-sparkline tooltip state
Export specs include color tokens, spacing scale, iconography (SVGs), font sizes, and accessibility contrast notes
Design handoff package linked with a short PRD and example dashboard API query snippets for engineering
PM and Eng review completed and sign-off recorded in comments
deliverables: Figma file: GlanceBar / components and variants
PNG export set: hero@2x, hover-trace@2x, tooltip-cost@2x, mobile-stack@2x
Annotated spec doc (Confluence) with layout grid and animation guidance
Handoff ZIP: SVG icons, CSS tokens, screenshot assets, and alt text copy
review_feedback: PM (Aisha Patel): prefer p95 marker to be visually prominent; reduce color saturation on cost-sparkline to avoid alarm fatigue
Eng (Jared Klein): request micro-interaction spec for trace hover to minimize DOM updates; prefer SVG over raster for sparkline icons
Accessibility (Riley Morgan): ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for primary text in narrow mode; provide keyboard focus states for hover expansions
decisions_and_tradeoffs: Chose single-line GlanceBar instead of stacked cards to minimize cognitive load during onboarding
Reduced detail in mini-trace preview (collapsed view with 1–2 levels) to keep initial render fast; full trace still available in Console Traceboard
Opted for subtle motion (200ms ease) for hover expansion to signal interaction without delaying main page load
